note: Chippewa NF campground on the east shore of Cut Foot Sioux Lake at the narrows, next to Lake Winnibigoshish, 2 mi W of Highway 46 about 15 mi N of Deer River: upper and lower loops in birch, oak and pine with a boat landing and swimming beach between them. Sites 008, 014 and 015 look out on the lake through the trees. The Simpson Creek trailhead is a short boat crossing away. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + catalog + FS page read: 16 back-in nonelectric sites (FS says 17), driveways 30-70 ft, 10 reservable 4+ days ahead and 6 first come, $16 in 2026 and 2027, hand-pump water and vault toilets. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (sites under canopy 30-45 m from shore; rec.gov 'A few campsites have lake views'). Phone corrected. Season (manual) agrees.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview proposed (stored value is not --AWH; no waterfront_evidence on file). recreation.gov tags four sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' - 008 (47.50397,-94.06329), 011 (47.50314,-94.06406), 014 (47.50292,-94.06485), 015 (47.50271,-94.06500) - but its own description says only 'A few campsites have lake views.' On Esri leaf-on imagery every site sits under continuous canopy: 015 and 014 are about 30-35 m from the shore and 008 about 45 m (behind the shoreline reeds), 011 about 65 m, all through trees. The 2013 leaf-off frame shows deciduous woods, not open ground, between those sites and the water. The rec.gov photos show the lake through tree trunks from 008, 014 and 015 (filtered view) and no lake from 011. No site is on open ground within ~50 m of the water, so lakefront fails; a filtered view from three RV sites supports lakeview.
